ai_summary.text:
システムサポートはクラウドとDXに特化したIT企業。Oracle・Google Cloud・AWS等のクラウド基盤構築を主力に、ERP導入支援とDXコンサルティングを展開している。

売上269億円（前年比+22.3%）と大幅増収。営業利益22億円（営業利益率8.2%）、純利益15億円。クラウド移行案件の拡大とDXコンサルの受注増が業績を牽引。ROE24.2%と高い資本効率。

自己資本比率44.1%、財務健全性スコア83点。営業CF24億円、FCF16億円と安定したキャッシュ創出。EPS141円に対しPER19.1倍、配当50円。企業のクラウド移行は構造的に進んでおり、Oracle・Google Cloudの認定パートナーとしての技術力が安定した受注の基盤を形成している。なお、EPS141.4円、PER19.1倍、1株当たり配当金50.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: System Support is an IT company specializing in cloud and DX. It focuses on cloud infrastructure construction for Oracle, Google Cloud, AWS, etc., and provides ERP implementation support and DX consulting.  Sales increased significantly to  26.9 billion (up 22.3% year-on-year). Operating income was  2.2 billion (operating margin of 8.2%) and net income was  1.5 billion. The expansion of cloud migration projects and increased orders for DX consulting drove performance. High capital efficiency with an ROE of 24.2%.  Equity ratio of 44.1%, financial soundness score of 83 points. Stable cash generation with operating CF of  2.4 billion and FCF of  1.6 billion. EPS of  141 with a PER of 19.1x, dividend of  50. The cloud migration of companies is progressing structurally, and the company's technical capabilities as a certified partner of Oracle and Google Cloud form the basis for stable orders. EPS is at  141.4, PER at 19.1x, and dividend per share at  50.0, promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
